hero: What do you want to do?
intro: Pick a goal. We’ll help you gather what you need.
search: Search English name or item ID
none: Nothing found. Try a different search or category.
unavailable: Recipe data is unavailable. You can still use your own recipes.
fallback: Recipe data could not be verified. Only the separate ID catalog is available.
planned: This guide is not ready yet. You can browse crafting items below.
gameNames: Game names are shown in the source’s English. Interface translations are separate.
dated: Dated community snapshot. Exact game build unknown; check your game.
credit: Data: HySphere • non-commercial use with attribution
missing: No complete recipe is available for this item. Add your own after checking it in game.
knowledge: Recipe knowledge is required in game.
lineHelp: One per line: original item ID (or your recipe name): quantity. Saved only in this browser.
clipboard: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the list manually.
planHelp: Several goals, one shared inventory. One per line: item ID: quantity. User recipes use their names.
incomplete: Some intermediate recipes are incomplete. Obtain these items separately:
cycle: This crafting chain has a cycle. Choose an intermediate item to obtain separately.
badQuantity: Enter a whole quantity from 1 to 999999.
badLines: Use one line per item: ID or name: positive whole quantity.
limit: The calculation is too large or too deep. Reduce the quantity or shorten the chain.
error: Unable to complete this action. Check the data and try again.
storage: Browser storage is unavailable or full. Export a backup; changes were not saved.
corruptUser: Saved recipes could not be read. Existing data was kept. Export it before making changes.
name: Item ID or custom name
userNotice: User recipe — not a confirmed game recipe.
confirmImport: Replace your saved user recipes with this backup?
confirmOverwrite: Replace the existing user recipe with this name?
badImport: Invalid recipe backup. Nothing was replaced.
recipeLimit: Up to 500 recipes and 50 ingredients per recipe are supported.
noRecipes: No user recipes yet. Add one in the editor.
privacy: Your inventory and plans stay in this browser. No ads, analytics, account or tracking cookies. Hosting may keep access logs.
art: Original vector scene prototypes, not official Hytale assets.
notOfficial: Unofficial fan tool. Hytale belongs to its rights holders.
localHelp: Back up your recipes before changing devices.
noGoals: Add at least one crafting goal.
readOnly: This source has item IDs only, without recipe ingredients.
recipeError: The selected recipe is unavailable or incomplete.
invalidName: Enter a name of 1–100 characters and a source note of at most 500 characters.
changeSource: Changing the source keeps its plans separate.
